text_block_list.text:
One day, Loves Only You was appearing at a
fan event alongside other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Really, whenever work is tough, seriously...!
Love-chan's streams give me so much strength...!
They're my reason to live... All I have is gratitude...!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm the one who should be thanking you!
For coming all the way here today to share your "love" with me♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep doing tons and tons of streams!
Let's find lots of fun things together, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuuuuuuugh...!!!!
I'm so glad to be aliveeee...!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Love-chan! Flawless fan service!
Everyone's heading home with a smile a hundred miles wide.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Truly... you are incredible.
I want to properly repay the kindness I've received, just like Love-chan, but..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying, Chrono-chan?! Look at your fans,
they've all got great big smiles on their faces too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm only managing the bare minimum.
I can't entertain everyone like Love-chan does...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...If you think so, should we all do it together?
Let's wrap up the handshake event here and—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "A fan event where all our fans can participate too—named the 'Love Thanksgiving'!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then, next question! 'In the Arima Kinen that Fine Motion
competed in, who was the Umamusume that claimed victory
with her razor-sharp late-race surge—?' Alright, your answer please!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This one's easy!
It's Symboli Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh!? It's not!?
Even though I watched it right there at the track!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Regarding Symboli Kris S... What bracket number is she in—" Yes, Chrono-chan was the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gate 1, Stall 1!
By the way, Tap-san's impressive run in that Arima Kinen really stood out—

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I totally could've gotten that question right!
So frustrating...! But so fun...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now, things are heating up!
Gran-chan vs. 100 fans in a soccer juggling showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan juggling the ball alone vs. a relay of fans taking turns whenever someone drops it—who can keep juggling longer?!

text_block_list.name: Gran's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Only 28 people left already?!
Gran-chan, you're way too amazing, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Nice, nice! Everyone's smiling at 120 miles per hour! Now this is getting fun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right. Here we go, ready~?
And a one, two—Love you♡

text_block_list.name: Loves's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-Thank you, Love-chan!!!!
Having Love-chan hold the phone
for a selfie of the two of us... I'll cherish this for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I've actually been thinking for a while~.
While it's nice to just have everyone taking photos of me—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I thought if we took a selfie together like this, we could get an even mooore lovely picture! ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take pictures for as long as time allows today...
So let's make lots of wonderful memories, okay?
All the fans cheered in unison. And so, the fan event she organized was an incredible success—

The event came to an end. After telling her "good job,"
I shared with her the thought I had earlier.
choice_data_list: You were shining even brighter than usual today!
Somehow, you were shining even brighter than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Really?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I agree fifty miles with that!
Love-chan seemed even more dazzling than usual today...
I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I wonder why~? But maybe... it's because I was wearing such a wonderful racing silk?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you remember? Back then, when we all brainstormed ideas with our commu members to make outfits.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Staying up late debating what colors to use, where to
put the hearts... Hehe. It was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the outfit made like that...
is the crystallization of everyone's "love."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âJust wearing it makes me ache inside.
It makes me want to repay all the love I've been given.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...So I'm sure it's all thanks to everyone.
That I was able to share my love with the fans today."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I did it right. Heheh♡
choice_data_list: Hearing you say that makes me happy as a fellow member!
It's admirable that you want to repay what you've received.
It's admirable that you want to repay what you've received.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I did it right. Heheh♡
choice_data_list: Hearing you say that makes me happy as a fellow member!
It's admirable that you want to repay what you've received.
It's admirable that you want to repay what you've received.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Ufufu.
Did you feel my love?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...It's quite wonderful, isn't it?
I think it's a truly wonderful relationship, really.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Chrono-chan.
Right, yeah—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I think so too ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I'm just doing it
because it's what I want to do, though.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Love-chan's fan love is so amazing!
I've gotta follow her example! Like, fifty miles worth!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Oh, don't say you should follow my example.
I really haven't done anything special, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just doing as I please.
I'm just loving you, that's all ♡"
